title: party.order
description: FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.1, Q16: a SWITCH in the hidden party menu; Cobblemon reorders its party to match (R1: the lead is the same Pokémon in both).

uids.description: The hidden party's members with a uid, in their new order.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
